remarks: Welcome to this spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offering comfort and convenience in a central Stamford location. This inviting unit features a large living room and dining area, complemented by hardwood floors and high ceilings that enhance the sense of space and natural light. Updated kitchen and bathroom. Conveniently located on the first level, this unit provides easy access and everyday comfort. The well-maintained complex offers multiple laundry facilities and beautifully landscaped courtyards, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the outdoors. Heat and hot water are included in the rent for added value. 1 parking assigned and plenty visitors spots. Ideally situated close to all that Stamford has to offer, including public transportation, schools, shopping, dining, and more. Don't miss this wonderful rental opportunity-schedule your showing today!
